Details: Added an average-value tile to the sensor page and made the sensor title larger and clearer above the gauge.
Gaps in sensor readings now count as downtime in reports. Added Downtime and Average options to the report screen.
Settings to customize the sensor card's size, text and colors, with a live preview of the result. Settings page now uses the full screen width.
New location maps: upload a floor plan, place live sensor boxes on it, and draw rooms, walls, doors, windows, entries, exits and stairs. Server storage and access rules per user role.
Map editor with autosave, undo/redo, right-click menus, and sensor box shape, size and color options.
Actions recorded in History can now be undone from the History page.
Details card when hovering a user's name, and a right-click menu with the common user actions.
Admin can send a test push notification to a chosen user's phone to check delivery.
Sensor values on the map shown in their status color (OK, warning, down and so on).
Started HTTP device support: devices can send readings over HTTP instead of MQTT.
View on Map popup from any sensor, snap to grid in the editor, and Back returns to the page you came from.
Admin can send a test SMS to a chosen user to check SMS delivery.
Web-based simulator that sends device readings in the PRTG HTTP push format, for testing HTTP devices without hardware.
Finished HTTP devices: readings received on port 5055 in PRTG format alongside MQTT, offline detection when a device goes silent, and a per-owner removal timeout.
Acknowledge, un-acknowledge, resolve and Clear on alerts now stay in sync between the web and the phone app, live. Users can turn their own email/SMS/push notifications on or off, synced both ways.
New messaging system: chats between the master admin, super admins and their users, plus announcements to selected users, groups or locations. Live delivery, push to phones, unread counts.
Written implementation instructions for the Android app: alert and notification sync, and location maps.
Investigated the repeated 504 errors (server running out of memory). Removed the memory cap and added an automatic watchdog that restarts the web server before it slows down.
Simplified messaging: removed the separate Issue/Service/Help screens; announcements now land in each person's chat so they can reply.
WhatsApp-style layout with a single new-chat button instead of several, and clearer wording for selected users, groups and locations.
Master admin can write a message and push it to chosen people. It shows on top of their alerts until they clear it, and the admin sees who has cleared it.
Pause a sensor from its menu for a set time (15 minutes to 7 days) or until a date and time; it resumes by itself.
Phone numbers limited to 9 digits after +972. New users get Email and Push alerts by default (SMS optional). Alert table actions always visible.
Written implementation instructions for the Android app: messaging, custom notifications and timed pause.
Planned pause from one date and time to another, and a daily pause on every day or selected days. The server starts and ends them automatically.
New HTTP sensors are named in the Device_key format (e.g. 4C9A5E_temp3) with short unit names.
Fixed location pages showing 'page not found'. The automatic restart now waits for the old server to stop fully, and its health check also tests location pages.

A sensor with a planned pause shows in blue, and one click on 'Resume Pause' cancels the plan. Saving a sensor's settings no longer cancels a planned pause. Sensor preview no longer opens over the right-click menu.
